description: Uninstall a kit from a Game Kit project (gkp_…). Remove a kit the user installed (addedBy user in gripforge_gamekit_installed) only when the user asks. game.engine (the engine of the game) and the default kits (ui.menu, input.remap, settings.graphics, ui.prompts, ui.endscreen, save.persistence, audio.core, i18n.text, ui.theme, input.virtualpad, display.fullscreen, asset.preload, asset.cache, ai.navigation on web, addedBy default) are removed only when the user explicitly asks — never to "clean up". A kit other kits depend on, and game.engine always, is not removed by a first call: it answers 409 (kit_in_use, or confirm_required) with details { dependents, confirm } — nothing applied; show the user the dependents, then call again with with_dependents=true and confirm=<token> to remove the kit and its dependents together (the token is bound to the project revision). dry_run=true returns the plan, the dependents and the token without writing. force=true (legacy) removes it and disables its dependents instead; prune=true also drops the dependencies nothing else needs (never game.engine nor a default kit). Returns { applied, removed[], dependents, project }. 0 credits.

confirm.description: The confirm token of the previous answer, after the user saw the dependents.

dry_run.description: true to return the removal plan (with the dependents and the confirm token) without writing.

force.description: Legacy: remove even when other kits depend on it; they are disabled, not removed.

id.description: Kit id from the catalogue, dotted (e.g. vehicle.driveable, mission.objectives).

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

prune.description: true to also remove dependencies that no remaining kit requires (never game.engine nor a default kit).

reason.description: One sentence: why you do this, recorded in the project history (required in spirit when you go against the installed-kits rule).

with_dependents.description: true to remove the kit AND the kits that depend on it (needs confirm).

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_gamekit_remove
title: Uninstall a Game Kit from a project
